# Libertty ▸ Settings… (⌘,): Rex's Settings window. Each change is one line
# of the config file, written in place (its comments and other lines as they
# were). Runs with a config folder of its own (@CFG@): two comments,
# font-size = 14 and tab-bar = left.
key:cmd+,
wait:0.8
expect-settings:page=Interface
expect-settings:Left Side=1
settings:mark
# Tab style ▸ Above: tab-bar = left becomes tab-bar = top, where it was.
settings:press:Above
expect-settings:Above=1
expect-config-change:tab-bar = top
shot:settings-interface.png
# Themes, from the sidebar: a light theme chosen writes only the light half of theme.
settings:press:Themes
wait:0.5
expect-settings:Libertty Light theme=Selected
settings:press:Catppuccin Latte theme
expect-settings:Catppuccin Latte theme=Selected
expect-config-change:theme = light:Catppuccin Latte,dark:Libertty Dark
shot:settings-themes.png
# Search: "cursor", Return, and it's the Terminal page.
settings:search:cursor
expect-settings:page=Terminal
shot:settings-terminal.png
# remote-control is found under Integrations (libertty +set doesn't change it).
settings:search:remote control
expect-settings:page=Integrations
# ssh's TERM and terminfo are with the hosts, which the page lists.
settings:search:ssh-terminfo
expect-settings:page=Remote Hosts
shot:settings-remote-hosts.png
# What was there before is still there.
expect-shell:cat '@CFG@/config' ==> # Settings writes its lines in place: this stays.
expect-shell:grep -c '^font-size = 14$' '@CFG@/config' ==> 1
